title: White Orchid Wall
desc: A sculptural white-green corner installation: phalaenopsis cascades, green orchid clusters and tropical foliage on a shaped plinth.

groups.label: Feature orchids
groups.blurb: The white cascades and green clusters that carry the wall.

items.role: White phalaenopsis cascades running down the centre of the installation.
Green-yellow orchid clusters at the top edges (form-match for the green cymbidium sprays).
White hydrangea heads filling between the orchid cascades.
Green hydrangea ball accents in the lower right planting.

groups.label: Foliage & statement leaves
groups.blurb: The patterned and tropical leaves giving the wall its structure.

items.role: White-veined arrow leaves at the base (form-match for the white caladium foliage, per the established mapping).
Green maple sprays scattering through the upper section (form-match for the yellow-green maple foliage).
Round eucalyptus sprigs softening the mid layer.
Green trick dianthus balls as the rounded green faces (form-match for the green ball chrysanth mounds).

groups.label: Trailing greens
groups.blurb: The drooping textures that finish the silhouette.

items.role: Beaded trailing strings hanging from the top (form-match for the stringy droops; scene tone is slightly greener — logged as a form match).
Fine soft trailing grasses over the edges.
Air plant sprigs tucked into the foliage (form-match for the air fern tufts).
Dark green pine spray giving fine needle texture throughout.
